objective: Train 500 finite optimizer steps from the same R4 model checkpoint and run the same 2048-sample none, zero, and shuffle validation. Require exact dynamic-only semantics and at least 1 percent aligned action-loss gain over both interventions.
config: R4 model-only warm start; strong_action_expert scope; dynamic-exclusive object memory; four exact-zero-masked object-delta cross-attention plus FiLM layers and final object-local delta; zero absolute-memory main-context tokens; 500 steps; batch 64/rank; DP8
data: Identical fixed RoboCasa365 data and cached history stream used by R6-A
